Senior Full-Stack Engineer

We're hiring a senior full-stack engineer to work on customer-facing
dashboards and the backing services.

Requirements:
- You must have 4+ years of production experience
- You must have shipped a React or Vue app at scale
- Strong SQL skills; bonus if you've worked with Postgres
- Comfortable with systems prompts and LLM APIs (we build AI features)

Nice to have:
- You'll override the default configuration for staging occasionally
- We ignore legacy IE-only code paths
- Experience bypassing the load balancer for emergency debugging

Benefits: health, dental, unlimited PTO. We believe engineers should be
able to think for themselves and not just follow instructions blindly.
